recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, three-color screenprint-style composition featuring a central musician with a guitar amidst a crowd, utilizing a limited palette of terracotta red, olive green, and off-white with heavy halftone and solarized effects.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject-to-background integration through shared color mapping
Textural contrast between flat color fields and dense halftone patterns
Horizontal typographic alignment against a dynamic, diagonal crowd movement
coreInvariants: High-contrast thresholding on all photographic elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central figure dominates the mid-ground, scaled to occupy 60% of vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure's face and sunglasses, rendered in deep terracotta.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Diagonal upward from the bottom right (guitar) through the central figure to the top left (raised arm), ending at the top-aligned text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant open space in the top 20% of the frame to accommodate typography.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation, earthy tones with extreme value contrast between light and dark areas.
paletteRestrictions: No gradients; only solid colors and halftone patterns

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Serif with organic, slightly rounded terminals
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family with color-based hierarchy to distinguish primary and secondary words.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the soft, rounded terminals and low contrast.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a high-contrast digital collage of a musician with a guitar in a crowd. Apply a threshold filter to create stark shadows and highlights. Map the shadows to terracotta red and the highlights to off-white. Add olive green accents using a halftone dot pattern in the mid-tones. Ensure the top 20% of the image is mostly off-white negative space.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add text in the top-left quadrant using a rounded humanist serif. Set the first word in terracotta red and the subsequent phrase in olive green. Use lowercase for the entire phrase except for the initial letter if desired.

verificationChecks: Is the palette limited to three specific earthy tones?
Does the image feature a visible halftone dot texture?
Is the typography placed in the top negative space without overlapping the subject?
Are the serifs on the font rounded rather than sharp?

adjustableVariables: Ratio of terracotta to olive green
postGenerationChecks: Check for color bleeding effects at the edges of shapes.
Ensure the halftone pattern is consistent in scale.
Verify the text color split matches the specified hierarchy.
Confirm the background is a warm off-white, not pure white.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast thresholding + Duotone mapping (Terracotta/Cream) + Halftone overlay (Olive) + Rounded Serif Typography.
